scope: The analysis of extracellular vesicles (EVs) from biofluids has recently gained significant traction in the liquid biopsy field.
Here we introduce a rapid EV isolation method based on chemical affinity called EVtrap (extracellular vesicle total recovery and purification) for the EV phosphoproteomics analysis of human plasma.
EVs were isolated from human plasma samples (n = 5 biological replicates/group × 3 groups = 15), as described in Figure 5 using our EVtrap approach.
